Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

Load data
```{r}
mega_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv")
```

Matrices with entropy and density values per patient
```{r}
### Entropy values
df_entropy = entropy_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Spatial_cluster, Value_entropy, R.NR, PFS, PFS_event) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Spatial_cluster,
    values_from = Value_entropy
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

### Density values
df_density = mega_clusters %>%
  dplyr::select(AN, Cluster_type, Nombre_cluster_type_mm2) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Cluster_type,
    values_from = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2
  ) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("AN") 

traitData = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(R.NR, PFS, PFS_event)

df_entropy = df_entropy %>%
  dplyr::select(-R.NR, -PFS, -PFS_event)

write.csv(df_entropy, file = "../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv")
write.csv(df_density, file = "../input/MegaClusters_density.csv")
```

CD8 enrichment in megaclusters
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = Spatial_cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters",
       x = "Megaclusters",
       y = "Entropy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

CD8 enrichment per megacluster comparing response information
```{r}
ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```

Megaclusters density per megacluster comparing response
```{r}
ggplot(mega_clusters, aes(x = Cluster_type, y = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +

  ) +

```

        border = T, cluster_columns = dend_column,

        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"),

Extract groups
```{r}
hc = hclust(dist(scale(df_density_scale)), method = "ward.D2")
k = 3
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)
plot(hc, main = "Patients groups", xlab = "", sub = "", cex = 0.8)
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = 2:4)

traitData = traitData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = clusters)
```

Function for survival analysis
```{r}
compute.survival.analysis = function(features, survival.data, time_unit, p.value = 0.05, thres = 0.5, max_factors = Inf) {
  library(survival)
  n_features <- ncol(features)
  significant_combinations <- list() # To store significant feature combinations
  
  # Generate all possible combinations of the features
  contador = 1
  for (n in 1:min(n_features, max_factors)) {
    combinations <- combn(1:n_features, n, simplify = FALSE)
    
    for (comb in combinations) {
      # Create a formula dynamically based on the combination
      formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time, status) ~", paste(colnames(features)[comb], collapse = " + ")))
      
      # Prepare the data for survival analysis
      data_for_model <- data.frame("time" = survival.data$PFS,
                                   "status" = survival.data$PFS_event,
                                   "groups" = survival.data$Groups) 
      
      data_for_model = cbind(data_for_model, features[,comb, drop=F])
      
      # Perform Krustal-Wallis test for have clear the direction
      feature_name <- colnames(features)[comb]
      x = data_for_model %>%
        dplyr::mutate(feature = data_for_model[,feature_name])
      
      kruskal_result <- kruskal.test(x$feature ~ x$groups)
      p_kruskal <- signif(kruskal_result$p.value, 3)
      
      # Perform Kaplan-Meier based on coxHL
      km_fit <- survival::survfit(survival::Surv(time, status)~groups, data=data_for_model)

      pval <- survminer::surv_pvalue(km_fit, data = data_for_model)$pval #Performs log-rank test to see whether both survival curves are significantly different

      if (!is.na(pval) && pval < p.value) {

        significant_combinations[[contador]] <- formula
        names(significant_combinations)[contador] = paste0("Formula_", contador)
        
        # Create boxplots
        box_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(x, ggplot2::aes(x = groups, y = feature, fill = groups)) +
          ggplot2::geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
          ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.6) +
          ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Cell Type Abundance vs Cluster groups"),
                        subtitle = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", p_kruskal),
                        x = "Risk Group",
                        y = feature_name) +
          ggplot2::theme_minimal()

        pdf(paste0("Results/Boxplot_Krustal_", feature_name), width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
        print(box_plot)
        dev.off()
      
        ### Set colors of each curve with the correct order 
        strata_names <- gsub("coxHL=", "", names(km_fit$strata)) 
        legend_labels <- strata_names
        legend.labs = legend_labels

        pdf(paste0("Results/SurvPlot_", names(significant_combinations)[contador]), width = 10, height = 5, onefile = FALSE)
        print(survminer::ggsurvplot(km_fit,
                         data = data_for_model,
                         size = 1,
                         conf.int = TRUE,
                         pval = TRUE,
                         risk.table = F,
                         legend.labs = legend.labs,
                         ggtheme = theme_grey()
        ))
        dev.off()
        contador = contador + 1
      }
      
    }
  }
  
  if (length(significant_combinations) == 0) {
    print("No significant combinations found.")
  } else {
    return(significant_combinations)
  }
  
}
```

Compute survival analysis
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(df_density_scale, traitData, "months", p.value = 0.05, thres = 0.5, max_factors = 1)
```

Save patient group info
```{r}
save(traitData, file = "Patients_groups.RData")
```
